mechanism: Cenobamate is a moderate CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce hydrochlorothiazide levels; additive hyponatremia and electrolyte abnormalities possible with thiazide diuretics.
action: Monitor serum sodium and electrolytes regularly; assess blood pressure control and consider alternative antiepileptic if hyponatremia develops; no dose adjustment typically required but clinical monitoring is warranted.
